run_adsorption_energy_analysis: run the script to parse adsorption energy data and generate parity plots for MOF structures
parse_adsorption_energy_data: parse the adsorption_energy.txt file to extract MOF names, defect info, and adsorption energies
filter_promising_mofs: filter MOF structures where CO2 adsorption energy is less than H2O adsorption energy and below -0.5 eV
generate_parity_plot: generate a scatter plot comparing CO2 vs H2O adsorption energies for pristine and defective MOFs
download_odac_data: download the ODAC dataset files using the fairchem core download_large_files utility
